entry.title: Direct Messages (DMs)
entry.summary:
Efforts are underway to connect with user @neonrooks in order to obtain their npub. This action is prompted by the recent addition of their song, "Off the Chain," to [btcplaylist.com](https://btcplaylist.com). The goal is to enable listeners to send zaps directly to the artist, thereby supporting them more effectively.
Due to the absence of a direct messaging feature on the current forum, alternative methods are being considered to reach out and facilitate this process.
